evars.name: ECID
evars.description: Adobe Experience Cloud ID auto-collected by AEP Web SDK. Primary visitor identity.

evars.name: Page URL
evars.description: Full page URL of the current hit. Baseline dimension for all pages (BRD 101).

evars.name: Business Unit
evars.description: Business unit / brand owner for the property. Baseline dimension on every hit.

evars.name: Environment
evars.description: Environment flag (production/staging) powering the Production Data Only segment.

evars.name: Tracking Code (s.campaign)
evars.description: Native campaign tracking code sourced from URL query parameter (BRD 101).

evars.name: Marketing Channel
evars.description: OOTB Marketing Channel processing-rule dimension. Processing rules required (not defined here).

evars.name: Campaign Source
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — traffic source.

evars.name: Campaign Medium
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — medium.

evars.name: Campaign Name
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — campaign name.

evars.name: Campaign Content
evars.description: SAINT classification of s.campaign — creative/content variant.

evars.name: Geo Location
evars.description: OOTB geo-segmentation dimensions derived by Adobe from IP. Raw GPS never stored (BRD 1802).

evars.name: Device Type
evars.description: OOTB device/mobile dimensions from user-agent — supports responsive/mobile-first reporting (BRD 103).

evars.name: New vs Return Visitor
evars.description: OOTB return-frequency dimension — supports returning-visitor contextual banner (BRD 704).

evars.name: Page Name
evars.description: Human-readable page name on every hit (BRD 101).

evars.name: Site Section
evars.description: Top-level site section for content grouping across all pages (BRD 101).

evars.name: Page Type
evars.description: Records the type of page being viewed, including distinguishing venue detail pages from venue listing pages. (BRD 104, 107, 108, 1812)

evars.name: Brand Compliance Flag
evars.description: Flags whether the page conforms to Heritage SG brand guidelines and carries the standard government disclaimer (BRD 106/109).

evars.name: Programme / Installation ID
evars.description: Unique AEMaaCS ID of the programme/installation in context (BRD 104).

evars.name: Programme / Installation Title
evars.description: Display title of the programme/installation (BRD 104).

evars.name: Venue Name
evars.description: Venue associated with the programme/installation listing (BRD 104/401).

evars.name: Programme Schedule
evars.description: Programme date/time window shown on listing detail (BRD 104).

evars.name: Unlocked Content Status
evars.description: Whether optional unlocked content is present/visible for a scanned-in visitor (BRD 602/605/1104).

evars.name: First Festival Year
evars.description: firstFestivalYear content-model field flagging debut programmes/installations (BRD 1104).

evars.name: Login / Registration Status
evars.description: Registered vs unregistered visitor. Registration is optional with full content access (BRD 201/203).

evars.name: Hashed Visitor ID
evars.description: [Hashed — PII] Registered visitor profile ID, SHA-256 hashed in JS before collection. Never expiration (BRD 204/604/304).

evars.name: Registration Trigger Moment
evars.description: Context/moment that triggered the registration prompt (first QR scan, itinerary adoption, etc.) — funnel reporting by trigger (BRD 603/506/1205).

evars.name: Consent Tier State
evars.description: Three-tier consent state (Tier 0 Functional / Tier 1 Festival Marketing / Tier 2 Year-Round NHB). Unbundled, unchecked by default (BRD 301/302).

evars.name: Consent Action
evars.description: Consent action recorded (grant/withdraw) for the consent log, effective immediately (BRD 303/304).

evars.name: Cookie Consent Category State
evars.description: Cookie consent category states (Strictly Necessary / Analytics & Performance / Personalisation & Targeting). No pre-ticked acceptance (BRD 1808/1809/1811).

evars.name: Student Cohort Flag
evars.description: Derived student cohort flag from geolocation cluster, visit timing and referral source. Not stored as permanent PII; refreshed annually (BRD 1806).

evars.name: QR Scan Installation ID
evars.description: Installation ID captured on a QR check-in scan. Venue check-in derived from QR only, not GPS (BRD 601/604/1803).

evars.name: Trail Name
evars.description: Selected curated self-guided trail name (BRD 501/502).

evars.name: Trail Progress / Check-in Step
evars.description: Trail progress tracked via QR check-ins — current step / completion ratio (BRD 502).

evars.name: Itinerary ID
evars.description: Custom itinerary identifier for created/shared/adopted itineraries incl. Community Picks (BRD 503/506/507).

evars.name: Itinerary Share Method
evars.description: Native device share channel used for itinerary sharing (no social OAuth) (BRD 505/705).

evars.name: Itinerary Optimisation Suggestion
evars.description: Type of dismissible inline optimisation suggestion surfaced for itinerary conflicts/inefficiencies (BRD 504).

evars.name: Klook CTA Destination
evars.description: Off-site Klook ticketing CTA destination clicked (exit link). No ticketing built on SNF site (BRD 105).

evars.name: Map Interaction Type
evars.description: Interaction type on the Bras Basah–Bugis MapBox map (pin tap, zoom, directions). Map by Adobe using MapBox (BRD 401/402).

evars.name: Location Permission State
evars.description: Location permission grant/deny state driving proximity sorting vs default listing. Geolocation client-side only (BRD 403/404/1802).

evars.name: Listing Sort Mode
evars.description: Active listing sort/auto-sort mode (proximity, current-night, last-chance post-9pm) (BRD 403/404/701).

evars.name: Personalisation Use Case
evars.description: Adobe Target personalisation use case in context (Your picks tonight, Trending with your circle, returning banner) (BRD 702/703/704/706).

evars.name: Personalisation Experience / Variant
evars.description: Adobe Target activity/experience variant served — supports lift & conversion reporting (BRD 706/1203).

evars.name: Session Loop Cluster Hash
evars.description: [Hashed] Session hash cluster key powering 'Trending with your circle' chip. Non-PII hashed cluster id (BRD 703).

evars.name: Brand Concierge Query Intent
evars.description: Classified visitor intent for a Brand Concierge query (programme discovery, trail rec, venue info, general) (BRD 1405/1406).

evars.name: Brand Concierge Outcome
evars.description: Outcome of a Brand Concierge interaction (answered, escalated, failed) for engagement/escalation reporting (BRD 1406).

evars.name: AI / Agent Crawler Source
evars.description: Identifies AI-powered / agentic crawler source for GEO & LLMO visibility reporting (BRD 901/902/1303).

evars.name: Social Share Surface
evars.description: Social sharing surface / Open Graph–Twitter Card context on programme detail and shareable itinerary pages (BRD 1001/1002).

evars.name: Content Author / Publish Source
evars.description: AEMaaCS publish source/channel (independent author publish vs migration) for content governance reporting (BRD 1102/1103).

evars.name: Newsletter Subscription Topic
evars.description: Captures the topic selected when a visitor submits a newsletter sign-up form. (BRD 1950)

props.name: Page URL
props.description: Mirrors the Page URL eVar to enable PathFinder pathing analysis across the SNF site. Captures the full page URL on every hit.

props.name: Business Unit
props.description: Mirrors the Business Unit eVar to enable ClickMap / PatternMatch segmentation of pathing by business unit. Constant value for the SNF site.

props.name: Page Name
props.description: Mirrors the Page Name eVar to enable PathFinder pathing across programme, installation and content pages. Supports requirement 104 (programme/installation listing display tracking).

props.name: Site Section
props.description: Mirrors the Site Section eVar to enable PatternMatch / ClickMap analysis of section-level navigation across the festival site.

props.name: Programme Name
props.description: Mirrors the Programme Name eVar to support content pathing analysis of which programmes/installations visitors traverse. Supports requirement 104.

props.name: Venue Name
props.description: Mirrors the Venue Name eVar to enable PathFinder analysis of venue-to-venue navigation on the precinct map and listings. Supports requirement 401 (interactive precinct map).

props.name: Trail Name
props.description: Mirrors the Trail Name eVar to enable pathing analysis of which curated self-guided trails visitors view and follow. Supports requirement 501 (trail presentation).

props.name: Registration Flow Step
props.description: Mirrors the Registration Journey Step eVar to enable PathFinder analysis of the email registration funnel flow. Supports requirement 201 (email registration verification).

props.name: Installation ID
props.description: Mirrors the Installation ID eVar to enable PatternMatch analysis of QR check-in sequences across installations. Supports requirement 604 (QR scan events / confirmed check-ins).
